provenance: Original generic JavaScript mechanics authored for Luna MiniCoder V3. No external, commercial, KOM, Elsword, or Grand Chase code.

tasks.objective: Move a platform character horizontally using clamped input, speed, and delta time.
Apply an upward jump impulse only when jump is pressed while grounded.
Advance vertical velocity and position by gravity for one delta-time step.
Return whether two positive-area axis-aligned rectangles overlap; edge contact is not overlap.
Subtract non-negative damage and keep hit points between zero and maximum health.
Move an enemy within horizontal bounds and reverse direction at a reached bound.
tasks.parameters: x, direction, speed, dt, minX, maxX

tasks.objective: Mark a collectible as taken once the player is within the inclusive pickup radius.
Decrease a countdown by delta time without allowing it to become negative.
Advance an actor from idle to windup on a start event, and from windup to active when its timer expires.
Launch a body upward only on contact with a spring while descending.
Move a platform toward its target by at most speed times delta time without overshooting.
Report whether a repeating hazard is active during its configured active portion.
Choose chase when a player is inside the sensor radius, otherwise choose return when away from home, or idle at home.
